https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body: In Sokoto, the state government ordered the indefinite closure of the ADC campaign office less than 48 hours before the party’s presidential campaign flag-off scheduled for November 4. The Commissioner for Lands and Housing, Barrister Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho, announced the sealing during an official visit to the premises on Monday, November 2, 2026, according to an update posted by Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu. The development is the latest in a face-off between the ADC and the Sokoto State Government that has dominated the state’s political space over the past week. The dispute began when the ADC notified the state government of its decision to hold its presidential campaign flag-off in Sokoto, the seat of the Caliphate. The event was initially scheduled for October 31. In its response, the state government expressed disagreement with the proposed event, a position the ADC described as troubling and a threat to political pluralism. The party subsequently rescheduled the flag-off to Wednesday, November 4. At a press conference at the party’s headquarters in Sokoto on Sunday, November 1, the Director-General of the ADC Governorship Campaign and state chairman, Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo, alleged a pattern of attacks and intimidation against the party and its supporters. Goronyo said ADC women supporters were attacked during a peaceful solidarity march on Wednesday, October 28, with their phones allegedly snatched, clothes torn and vehicles vandalised. He also alleged that the party’s state campaign office was attacked the same day, with windows and doors smashed, property looted and three motorcycles destroyed. He added that the party’s billboards, posters and other campaign materials were destroyed across the state. According to him, the ADC governorship candidate was attacked on Friday, October 30, while gunshots were fired at the airport as party leaders arrived. Goronyo further alleged that hotels which had confirmed reservations for ADC delegates cancelled their bookings under pressure from the state government, while government-owned hotels claimed they were fully booked. He linked the alleged attacks to the release from prison of two men associated with political thuggery, reportedly by the state government. He identified one Aliyu K.C. and his associates as being connected with the incidents. The ADC chairman also alleged that personnel of the Sokoto Community Guard Corps and Sokoto Marshals had been directed to prevent the party’s supporters from entering the state ahead of the flag-off. The closure of the campaign office marked another escalation in the dispute. The facility, a green-and-orange building in Sokoto metropolis, houses the party’s state campaign council. As of press time, the state government had not issued an official explanation for the sealing. However, sources in the Ministry of Lands said it might be connected to alleged violations involving land title and building permits. Despite the closure, the ADC has vowed to proceed with its November 4 presidential campaign flag-off. “No threat, intimidation or unlawful obstruction will deprive us of our constitutional right to organise political activities,” Goronyo said. He called on the Nigeria Police Force, the Department of State Services (DSS) and the Federal Government to investigate the alleged attacks and provide protection for the party’s candidates and supporters. In neighbouring Zamfara State, pandemonium broke out on Monday during the APC primary for the Zamfara North Senatorial District in Kaura Namoda, as the local government chairman, Hon. Mannir Haidara, narrowly escaped an attack by angry youths. LEADERSHIP gathered that the incident occurred at the primary election venue while Haidara was addressing delegates and urging them to vote for the incumbent senator representing the district, Senator Sahabi Ya’u Kaura. The youths, reportedly supporters of his challenger, Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura, rejected the appeal and insisted on backing their preferred candidate. Eyewitnesses said the situation degenerated as the youths shouted at the council chairman and attempted to attack him over alleged bias and imposition. Police officers and other security operatives at the venue intervened and rescued Haidara from the crowd. The primary is a contest between Senator Sahabi Ya’u and Senator Tijjani Yahaya Kaura for the APC ticket to represent Zamfara North, which comprises Kaura Namoda, Birnin Magaji, Shinkafi and Zurmi local government areas. Calm had been restored at the venue as of the time of filing this report, although security operatives maintained a heavy presence. Efforts to obtain Haidara’s reaction were unsuccessful, as his telephone was switched off. We’ve got the edge. https://leadership.ng/2027-sokoto-govt-s.body_zh: 在索科托，州政府下令无限期关闭人民民主大会党（ADC）竞选办公室，而距离该党原定于11月4日举行的总统竞选启动仪式已不足48小时。据Comr. Abdulazeez Adamu发布的消息，土地与住房事务专员Nasir Aliyu Dantsoho律师于2026年11月2日星期一正式视察该处场所期间宣布查封办公室。这是过去一周主导该州政治局势的ADC与索科托州政府对峙事件中的最新进展。争端始于ADC通知州政府，其决定在哈里发国教发源地索科托举行总统竞选启动仪式。该活动最初定于10月31日举行。州政府回应称不同意举办这项活动，ADC则称这一立场令人不安，并威胁政治多元。随后，该党将启动仪式改至11月4日星期三。11月1日星期日，在位于索科托的党总部举行的新闻发布会上，ADC州长竞选主任兼州主席Alhaji Bello Muhammad Goronyo指控该党及其支持者持续遭到袭击和恐吓。Goronyo称，10月28日星期三，ADC女性支持者在一场和平声援游行中遭到袭击，据称她们的手机被抢、衣服被撕毁，车辆也遭到破坏。他还称，同一天，该党州竞选办公室遭到袭击，窗户和门被砸，财物被抢，3辆摩托车被毁。他补充说，该党在各地的广告牌、海报和其他竞选 materials均被毁。据他介绍，10月30日星期五，ADC州长候选人遭到袭击；该党领导人抵达机场时，现场还响起了枪声。Goronyo进一步指控，已确认接待ADC代表入住的酒店在州政府施压下取消了预订，而政府所属酒店则声称已客满。他将这些所谓的袭击与据称由州政府释放的两名政治打手有关，并指出其中一人为Aliyu K.C.及其同伙与这些事件有关。ADC主席还称，索科托社区卫队和索科托法警人员已奉命阻止该党支持者在启动仪式前进入该州。竞选办公室关闭标志着争端进一步升级。该设施是一栋位于索科托市区、涂有绿色和橙色的大楼，内设该党州竞选委员会。截至发稿时，州政府尚未就查封一事发布正式解释。不过，土地部消息人士称，此事可能与土地所有权和建筑许可方面的违规行为有关。尽管办公室已被关闭，ADC仍誓言继续举行11月4日的总统竞选启动仪式。Goronyo说：“任何威胁、恐吓或非法阻碍，都不能剥夺我们组织政治活动的宪法权利。”他呼吁尼日利亚警察部队、国家安全局（DSS）和联邦政府调查这些所谓的袭击，并为该党候选人和支持者提供保护。在邻近的赞法拉州，星期一在考拉纳莫达举行的全非人民大会党（APC）赞法拉北区参议员初选中发生混乱。当时，地方政府主席Hon. Mannir Haidara在向代表发表讲话、敦促他们投票支持代表该区的现任参议员Sahabi Ya’u Kaura时，险些遭到愤怒青年的袭击。据《LEADERSHIP》获得的报道，事发时Haidara正在初选投票点讲话。报道称，这些青年是其所挑战的参议员Tijjani Yahaya Kaura的支持者。他们拒绝了Haidara的呼吁，坚持支持自己属意的候选人。目击者称，局势不断恶化，这些青年对地方政府主席大喊大叫，并因所谓偏袒和强行施压而试图袭击他。现场的警察和其他安全人员介入，将Haidara从人群中救出。此次初选是Sahabi Ya’u与Tijjani Yahaya Kaura争夺APC代表赞法拉北区的党内候选人资格。该区包括考拉纳莫达、比尔宁马加吉、欣卡菲和祖尔米4个地方政府。截至本报道提交时，现场局势已恢复平静，但安全人员仍大量驻守。由于Haidara的电话已关机，未能联系其本人置评。掌握第一手动态，实时获取突发新闻和独家报道，直接发送到你的手机。不要满足于过时新闻。加入LEADERSHIP NEWS的WhatsApp，享全天候更新 →

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110308.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 이신영 기자 = 중동 정세는 2일(현지시간) 바다 건너 미국 중간선거를 하루 앞에 두고 미국과 이란의 정면 충돌이 재개될지, 아니면 극적 외교 돌파구를 찾을지 긴박한 기류에 휩싸였다. 도널드 트럼프 대통령은 전쟁 반대 여론에 직면해 선거 판세에 빨간불이 켜진 가운데 이란과 협상에 진전을 시사했고, 이란도 카타르가 중재하는 회담에 수정안을 꺼내놓고 협상판에 불씨를 붙였다. 그러나 호르무즈 해협에서는 유조선 화재가 속출하고 미군이 이에 방어적 타격을 가하며 폭음이 이어지는 모양새다. 이날 이란의 호르무즈 해협 요충지인 게슘섬 인근에서는 여러 차례 폭발음이 들렸다고 이란 국영 IRNA 통신이 보도했다. 그러다 몇시간 뒤 월스트리트저널(WSJ)은 미국이 이날 게슘섬을 타격했으며, 이는 이란이 호르무즈 해협에서 상선을 자유롭게 공격하지 못하도록 막기 위한 방어적 성격의 조치였다고 미 당국자들을 인용해 보도했다. WSJ은 당국자를 인용해 미국이 이번 공습이 전면전으로 이어지는 상황을 피하기 위해 작전 상황을 조용히 진행해왔다고 설명했다. 이러한 움직임은 그간 트럼프 대통령이 중간선거 이후 이란 타격 위협을 고조시키다가 투표일을 하루 앞두고는 카타르가 중재하는 간접회담에서 진전을 시사한 와중에 나온 것이다. 이날 앞서 보도된 악시오스 인터뷰에서 트럼프 대통령은 이란 공격 재개 여부와 관련해 "서두를 필요는 없고, 대화가 잘 진행되고 있다"고 말했다. 비슷한 시점에 이란 외무부도 미국이 일련의 요구사항을 수용한다면 기존에 제시했던 호르무즈 개방을 위한 7단계 제안을 이틀 안에 이행할 수 있다며 일부 양보 의사를 내비쳤다. 이란은 또 최고지도자가 미국과 긴장 상태를 대화로 풀어나가기 위해 행정부에 협상의 재량권을 일부 부여했다고도 밝혔다. 뉴욕타임스(NYT)에 따르면 지난 10월 한 달간 호르무즈 해협에서 공격받은 선박은 35척으로 전쟁 발발 이후 가장 많았다. 영국 해사무역기구(UKMTO)도 2일 호르무즈 해협 인근에서 선박 1척이 미확인 발사체에 피격돼 우현에 구멍이 뚫렸다고 보고했다. 선원들은 모두 무사히 구출된 것으로 알려졌지만 UKMTO는 인근을 항해할 때 주의를 기울여 달라고 당부했다. 베냐민 네타냐후 이스라엘 총리도 집권 연장 운명이 걸린 총선 후 정국이 안갯속인 상황에서 미국 고위급과 접촉을 이어가면서 이란과 전면전 재개를 계속해서 종용하고 있다. 이런 사정 때문에 협상을 지켜보겠다는 트럼프 대통령의 발언도 실제로는 중간선거를 코앞에 둔 상황에서 비판 여론을 잠시 잠재우려는 방편이 아니냐는 분석이 나온다. 에스마일 바가이 이란 외무부 대변인은 이날 기자회견에서 미국과 이스라엘이 지난해 6월 이란과 협상을 진행하던 도중 대규모 공습을 감행했었다는 점을 지적했다. 중동 지역의 미국 동맹국들도 중간선거 직후 대규모 공습이 이뤄질 가능성이 있다고 보고 이란이 보복에 나서는 최악의 상황에 대비하고 있다. 이들은 이번에 무력 충돌이 재개된다면 이란의 보복에 따른 충격파가 과거보다 더 강력할 수 있다고 우려하고 있다. 안와르 가르가시 아랍에미리트(UAE) 대통령 외교정책 고문은 지난 주말 안보 콘퍼런스에서 "미국과 이란의 입장은 크게 엇갈려 있으며, 이런 입장 차가 좁혀지지 않는다면 최악의 상황을 우려해야 한다"고 말했다. 한편, 이란 강경파인 모흐센 레자이 최고국가안보회의(SNSC) 사무총장은 2일 블라디미르 푸틴 러시아 대통령과 전화 통화를 갖고 중동 정세 양국간 전략적 협력에 관해 논의한 것으로 전해진다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 11:46 송고 2026년11월03일 11시46분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110308.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者李申英＝在中东局势距美国中期选举仅剩一天之际，市场笼罩在紧张气氛中：美国与伊朗是否会重新发生正面冲突，还是会寻求戏剧性的外交突破，仍充满悬念。唐纳德·特朗普总统面对反战舆论，选举形势亮起红灯之际，暗示与伊朗的谈判取得进展；伊朗也拿出由卡塔尔斡旋的会谈修正方案，为谈判注入活力。然而，霍尔木兹海峡接连传出油轮起火事件，美军对此实施防御性打击，爆炸声持续不断。伊朗国营IRNA通讯社报道，当天在伊朗霍尔木兹海峡要冲格什姆岛附近多次传出爆炸声。数小时后，《华尔街日报》（WSJ）援引美国官员的话报道称，美国当天袭击了格什姆岛，此举具有防御性质，旨在阻止伊朗在霍尔木兹海峡自由袭击商船。WSJ还援引官员的话称，为避免此次袭击演变为全面战争，美国一直低调推进相关行动。上述动向出现在特朗普总统中间选举后曾加剧威胁打击伊朗、但在投票日前一天又暗示卡塔尔斡旋的间接会谈取得进展之际。当天稍早播出的艾哈迈德·沙赫西采访中，特朗普总统谈及是否恢复对伊朗的打击时表示：“不必着急，谈判进展顺利。”大约同一时间，伊朗外交部也表现出部分让步意愿，称如果美国接受一系列要求，伊朗便可在两天内履行此前提出的开放霍尔木兹海峡的七点方案。伊朗还表示，最高领袖已授予政府部分谈判裁量权，以通过对话化解与美国的紧张关系。据《纽约时报》（NYT）报道，过去10月一个月内，在霍尔木兹海峡遭袭的船只达到35艘，为战争爆发以来最高纪录。英国海事贸易行动办公室（UKMTO）也于2日报告，一艘船只在霍尔木兹海峡附近遭不明发射物击中，右舷被击穿。船员均已安全获救，但UKMTO提醒船只附近航行时务必提高警惕。以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡在延长执政任期面临大选的政局陷入僵局之际，继续与美国高层接触，并敦促伊朗不要重启全面战争。有分析人士认为，正因如此，特朗普总统关于将继续观望谈判的表态，实际上或许是为了在中期选举前夕暂时压制批评舆论。伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴加伊当天在记者会上指出，美国和以色列去年6月在伊朗斡旋谈判期间曾发动大规模空袭。中东地区的美国盟友也认为，大规模空袭有可能在中期选举后发生，正为伊朗实施报复的最坏情形做准备。这些国家担心，如果此次武力冲突重启，伊朗报复行动造成的冲击可能比过去更加强烈。阿联酋总统外交政策顾问安瓦尔·加尔加西在上周末的安全会议上表示：“美国与伊朗的立场存在巨大分歧，如果这种立场差异无法缩小，我们就必须为最坏的情况担忧。”另一方面，据报道，伊朗强硬派人物、最高国家安全委员会（SNSC）秘书长穆赫森·礼萨伊2日与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通电话，双方就中东局势下的两国战略合作展开讨论。报道发给卡友：KakaoTalk okjebo＜版权所有(c）韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再分发及用于人工智能学习和应用＞2026/11/03 11:46发稿，2026年11月3日11时46分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110306.title_zh: 李总统：扶助弱势群体的政策若缺乏公平性，将被煽动势力利用
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110306.body_zh:
（首尔=韩联社）林亨燮、黄允基记者＝李在明总统3日表示：“国家共同体有责任关注社会经济弱势群体的困境，并细致地为他们制定支援措施。”不过，“在这一过程中，公平性和合理性原则也必须得到一并考虑。”

李在明总统当天在青瓦台举行的国务院会议上，在全体与会人员发言环节作出上述表述。他强调：“即使看起来再小、再琐碎的优惠，如果在没有合理依据的情况下持续给予，也可能损害社会共同体对制度的信任。”

李在明强调：“这不仅会削弱政策可持续发展的基础，还可能给煽动针对弱势群体仇恨的势力提供炒作借口。不能对哪怕一块破碎的玻璃窗置之不理，才能预防更大的不信任和冲突，并更有力地保护弱势群体。”

他说：“政府应再次细致检查公共服务支援标准和执行情况；如果从国民视角出发，发现难以理解的不合理或不公平之处，就应迅速加以改善。请在考虑各种不同情况的同时，努力实现公平合理、能够获得社会共同体多数人认同的国政。”

此前，李在明总统上月28日在X平台引用了保守倾向较强的网络社区“佩姆韩国”（佩姆科）的帖子，表示将研究是否废除对多文化家庭的优待制度。对此，部分人士反对称，削弱对社会上弱势群体的支援并不妥当。

就此，李在明总统还反驳称：“也有人指责我歧视多文化家庭。”他表示，这并不符合事实。

李在明说：“保护政策是必要的。例如，过去存在被称为‘肤色’的做法，要消除这个名称，需要付出巨大努力。人难道一定非得是那种肤色吗？”他同时强调：“像这样逐一加以纠正，对于有必要保护的部分，就必须予以保护。”

不过，他也解释道：“然而，其中的某个小部分一旦被指责存在不合理之处并成为攻击目标，政策的可信度和可持续性就会遭到破坏。”

李在明提到：“我真正担心的是我们社会中的极端右翼煽动。就像现在的欧洲一样，他们是不是总想趁出现裂痕时，就划分立场、煽动敌意并发动攻击？”

他还以托儿所或炊事员优先录用为例反问：“是否应该无一例外地给予多文化家庭优先权？是不是只要朝着支援困难和辛苦群体的方向去做就可以了呢？”

https://leadership.ng/experts-outline-pa.body: Aviation experts have urged state governments to prioritise supporting infrastructure and sound business planning before committing billions of naira to aircraft acquisition and airline operations, warning that poorly conceived ventures could become drains on public finances. The warning comes as more states venture into commercial aviation. From Akwa Ibom’s Ibom Air to Enugu Air, Cross River’s Cally Air and Bayelsa’s Pioneer Airlines, governments are investing in airlines to improve connectivity, stimulate tourism, attract investors and create jobs. Speaking with LEADERSHIP, the experts said a state’s location, airport infrastructure, market potential, competition and operational capacity should inform the decision to establish an airline. Managing director of FlyBird Airline, Dr Akagwu Arume, said states must develop the infrastructure needed to sustain commercial aviation before establishing airlines. “The states must first develop these infrastructures before setting up these airlines,” he said. He advised governments to avoid ambitious expansion plans, invest in human capital and build operational capacity gradually. He also called for professional management and operational independence, saying airline executives should make commercial decisions without undue government interference. Similarly, aviation analyst Frank Oruye questioned the planning behind some state-backed projects, citing the Ogun State-backed Gateway Air. He argued that poor road access to the airport raised questions about the broader planning and economic rationale for the investment. Oruye said some state governments appeared to regard airline ownership as a prestige venture rather than a commercial investment requiring careful assessment. “Some of them are taking on airline ownership as a prestige venture, sure enough, and it’s going to ruin them even more. Because taking on aircraft, it’s not a child’s play – the resources required,” he said. He warned that states facing competing financial obligations could worsen their fiscal pressures by committing substantial public resources to aircraft acquisition and airline operations. Governments, he said, must establish the economic justification for such investments before committing public funds. Airlines operate in a capital-intensive industry, contending with volatile aviation fuel prices, foreign exchange fluctuations, aircraft leasing and maintenance costs, insurance premiums, airport charges and regulatory obligations. A former Nigerian Airways pilot, who spoke on condition of anonymity, said revenue figures alone could not establish an airline’s financial health. “An airline may generate substantial revenue without making a profit. It may also record an operating profit but struggle to generate enough cash to service debt, meet lease payments or finance aircraft replacement,” he said. He added that state-backed airlines should be assessed by their ability to cover operating costs, meet financial obligations, generate positive cash flow and deliver measurable economic benefits, rather than by aircraft acquired, routes announced, passengers transported or jobs promised. The absence of publicly accessible audited financial statements from some state-owned airlines, experts noted, also makes it difficult to establish their profitability, liabilities, operating costs and dependence on government funding. Experts are divided over the justification for state-backed airlines. While some believe they can bridge connectivity gaps and stimulate economic development, others warn that politically motivated ventures could become financial burdens. Former Rector of the Nigerian College of Aviation Technology, Capt. Sam Caulcrick, argued that regional airlines could be justified in areas where private operators had abandoned routes because of inadequate commercial returns. He cited the North-East, where six states have been exploring the possibility of establishing airlines, saying the region’s connectivity challenges required a different approach. According to him, such airlines should begin with smaller aircraft, particularly turboprops, to serve regional routes before expanding. “They should not start by competing with these big guys. Let them just move their people around their zone. They call it regional aviation, right? Small aeroplanes, propeller aeroplanes. Move your people around. With time, you will grow. And not compete,” he said. Comparing the situation with Alaska in the United States, Caulcrick said regional aviation there developed in response to inadequate services from larger commercial operators. He maintained that government investment in aviation should not always be judged by immediate financial returns where the objective is to provide essential connectivity and stimulate economic activity. “When a man is spending money, he is not spending money for profit. He is spending money for necessity. So this is necessity,” he said. Caulcrick also proposed government-backed aircraft leasing as an alternative to direct airline ownership. He identified high leasing costs as a major constraint facing Nigerian airlines and argued that governments could use access to relatively cheaper capital to make aircraft available to private operators at affordable rates. Citing Cally Air and Gateway Air, where private operators provide operational services, he said: “Look at it as if they are leasing. They are providing low cost leases. Because it’s government money. “They have this money now. Government money, they are not borrowing this money. It’s part of their allocation or whatever it is. “They are leasing at low cost to these airlines. These airlines, they are happy. ValueJet is happy that they run it for Ogun State. Aero is happy doing it for Cally Air.” He said affordable leasing could reduce aircraft-related expenses and free up resources for other operational costs. “So they can balance their books. That would pay for the high cost of operations in other areas for them. And that is the sustainability for them,” he said. However, such arrangements still expose governments to financial risks. Their viability depends on acquisition costs, lease terms and the value received by the state. Below-market leases must be transparently accounted for, with clear provisions covering maintenance, insurance, aircraft utilisation, payment defaults and asset recovery if an operator fails to meet its obligations. The survival of state-owned airlines beyond the administrations that establish them is another test of their viability. Arume said sustainability depends on whether an airline is established to drive economic development or serve political interests. He warned that ventures created for political reasons could collapse with the departure of the governors who established them. “The question about viability is not the issue. The question that we should be asking ourselves is, is the state airline being put together for political reasons or to drive development in the state? “If it is to drive development in the state, I would say it is viable. You can use Ibom Air as a case study. “If it is for political mechanisms, the airline will die with the end of the administration of the governor who set it up,” he said. He identified Ibom Air as an example of an airline that had benefited from continuity across successive administrations. Financial experts have raised concerns about Enugu Air’s sustainability, questioning whether its revenue and wider economic benefits justify public investment. They argued that the absence of publicly available audited financial statements makes it difficult to establish the airline’s profitability, liabilities, operating costs, government subsidies and annual funding requirements. An investigation by LEADERSHIP revealed that the Enugu State Government committed substantial resources to establishing and expanding the airline, including a reported N41 billion allocation in the 2025 fiscal year for acquiring four aircraft. Earlier, the then Commissioner for Transportation, Dr Obi Ozo, disclosed in an interview that the initial three Embraer aircraft cost about $40 million, equivalent to approximately N62 billion at the prevailing exchange rate. The total expenditure on the airline, including aircraft acquisition, operations, infrastructure and related investments, remains unclear. According to the state’s First Quarter 2026 Budget Performance Report, Enugu Air was its leading internally generated revenue source, recording N11.59 billion during the period. The airline has also been associated with technical and administrative job creation, including the emergence of an indigene of the state as a pilot. Its recent launch of the Enugu-Douala route in Cameroon is expected to strengthen cross-border trade, leisure travel and connectivity for members of the South-East diaspora, supporting the state’s ambition to position Enugu as a regional commercial and tourism hub. Speaking in an exclusive interview with LEADERSHIP, the Senior Special Assistant to Governor Peter Mbah on Policy and Communication, Comrade Ken Ofoma, described the airline as a profitable and sustainable investment that had continued to expand. He said flights from Enugu to Gatwick Airport in the United Kingdom were expected to commence by December 2026, while a Guangzhou, China, route was projected for the first quarter of 2027. “So the airline is one of the landmark investments of the state government as it is very much sustainable and also profitable. One of the fastest growing airlines in Nigeria today,” he said. Ofoma maintained that the airline’s operations had not undermined the state’s capacity to execute development programmes. “The operation of the airline does not interfere with the state’s execution of its programmes and projects. “The airline is part of integrated transport reform together with the three ultra modern bus terminals. And all dovetails into the tourism sector development. As you’re aware that about six tourism sites are being currently developed in the state,” he said. Akwa Ibom State-owned Ibom Air was established to provide an alternative revenue source, strengthen the state’s aviation sector and create jobs for its youths. According to its Group Manager, Marketing and Communications, Aniekan Essienette, the airline has seven Bombardier CRJ900 aircraft and three Airbus A220-300s, bringing its fleet to 10 following the recent acquisition of an A220-300 from Canada. It serves seven domestic destinations and operates international flights, including services to Accra, Ghana. However, its financial position remains difficult to assess independently because comprehensive financial statements detailing income, expenditure, liabilities and government support are not publicly accessible. Sources familiar with its operations told LEADERSHIP that the airline was financially healthy and adequately funded by the Akwa Ibom State Government. The state Commissioner for Information, Aniekan Umanah, said the government had continued investing in Ibom Air and expanding aviation infrastructure, including a Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) facility for routine checks and repairs of domestic and international aircraft. He said the investments were intended to strengthen the airline and position Akwa Ibom as a destination for tourism, business and investment. “The airline is well managed and maintained with all the risk factors involved – to live up to its mandate of making Destination Akwa Ibom a reality in line with the ARISE Agenda of His Excellency, Pastor Umo Eno. “That is why the administration, since coming on board, has been investing in Ibom Air and the expansion of the airport with the complementary Maintenance, Repairs and Overhaul (MRO) facility for routine checks and repairs of both local and international aircraft. “The idea is to make Akwa Ibom State a destination of choice for visitors, tourists and investors,” Umanah explained. https://leadership.ng/experts-outline-pa.title_zh: 专家勾勒国有航空公司实现良性运营的路径
https://leadership.ng/experts-outline-pa.body_zh:
航空专家敦促各州政府在投入数十亿奈拉购买飞机和运营航空公司之前，优先完善配套基础设施并制定合理的商业计划，并警告规划不当的项目可能拖累公共财政。随着越来越多的州进入商业航空领域，这一警示显得尤为重要。从阿夸伊博姆州的Ibom Air、恩古州的Enugu Air、克罗斯河州的Cally Air到巴耶尔萨州的Pioneer Airlines，各州政府都在投资航空公司，以改善交通连接、促进旅游业、吸引投资者并创造就业机会。FlyBird Airline董事总经理Akagwu Arume博士在接受《LEADERSHIP》采访时表示，各州应依据自身区位、机场基础设施、市场潜力、竞争环境和运营能力，决定是否设立航空公司。他说：“各州必须先建设这些配套设施，然后再成立航空公司。”他建议政府避免制定雄心勃勃的扩张计划，转而投资人力资本，逐步提升运营能力。他还呼吁实行专业管理和运营独立，指出航空公司管理层应在不受政府不当干预的情况下作出商业决策。

航空分析师Frank Oruye同样质疑部分州支持项目的规划依据，并提及由奥贡州支持的Gateway Air。他认为，通往机场的道路条件不佳，引发了对该项投资整体规划及经济合理性的疑问。Oruye表示，一些州政府似乎把持有航空公司视为彰显声望的事业，而不是需要严谨评估的商业投资。他说：“其中一些州肯定是在把持有航空公司当作一项声望工程，这只会让它们更加破败。因为接手飞机可不是闹着玩的——这需要大量资源。”他警告，面临相互竞争财政义务的州如果投入大量公共资源购买飞机和运营航空公司，可能进一步加剧财政压力。他说，政府在拨付公共资金之前，必须论证此类投资的经济合理性。航空公司所处行业资本密集，面临航空燃油价格波动、外汇汇率变化、飞机租赁和维护费用、保险费、机场收费以及监管义务等压力。一名前尼日利亚航空飞行员在匿名接受采访时表示，仅凭收入数字无法判断航空公司的财务状况。他说：“一家航空公司可能产生大量收入却没有利润。它也可能实现营业利润，却难以产生足够现金偿还债务、支付租赁款或为飞机更新提供资金。”他补充说，评估州支持的航空公司时，应关注其覆盖运营成本、履行财务义务、实现正向现金流并带来可量化经济效益的能力，而不应以购入的飞机、公布的航线、运送的旅客或承诺创造的就业岗位为依据。

专家还指出，一些国有航空公司不公开经审计的财务报表，因此难以确定其盈利能力、负债、运营成本以及对政府资金的依赖程度。专家对州支持航空公司的理由存在分歧。一些人认为，这些航空公司能够弥补交通连接缺口并促进经济发展；另一些人则警告，出于政治动机设立的项目可能成为财政负担。尼日利亚航空技术学院前院长Sam Caulcrick队长认为，在私人运营商因商业回报不足而放弃航线的地区， regional airlines（区域航空公司）的设立具有合理性。他提到东北地区正在探讨由6个州共同设立航空公司的可能性，并表示该地区的交通连接难题需要采取不同方法。他说，此类航空公司应先使用较小的飞机，尤其是 turboprops（涡桨飞机），服务区域航线，然后再逐步扩张。Caulcrick说：“它们不应一开始就与这些大型航空公司竞争。先让它们在各自区域内运送人员就行。他们称之为区域航空，对吧？小型飞机、螺旋桨飞机。让人们在区域内流动。随着时间推移，你会不断壮大，而且无需与大型企业竞争。”

Caulcrick将该地区与美国阿拉斯加的情况进行比较，指出当地区域航空是在大型商业运营商服务不足的情况下发展起来的。他坚持认为，如果目标是提供 essential connectivity（必要交通连接）并促进经济活动，政府对航空业的投资就不应始终以即时财务回报来衡量。他说：“一个人花钱时，不是为了利润而花钱，而是为了满足必要需求。所以这就是必要需求。”Caulcrick还提出，由政府提供飞机租赁可作为直接持有航空公司的替代方案。他把高昂的租赁成本列为尼日利亚航空公司面临的一项主要制约，并认为政府可利用获取相对廉价资本的优势，以可负担的租金向私人运营商提供飞机。他以Cally Air和Gateway Air为例，这些航空公司由私人运营商提供运营服务。他说：“可以把它理解为它们在出租飞机。它们提供低成本租赁，因为用的是政府的钱。‘它们现在有这笔钱。政府的钱，它们不用借款。这笔资金本来就是它们的拨款，或 whatever（无论是什么）。‘它们以低成本把这些飞机租给这些航空公司。这些航空公司对此很满意。ValueJet很高兴为奥贡州运营飞机。Aero也很高兴为Cally Air运营。’”他说，可负担的租赁能够减少与飞机有关的支出，为其他运营成本腾出资源。“这样它们就能实现收支平衡，从而支付其他领域的高昂运营费用。这就是它们实现可持续发展的途径。”

不过，这类安排仍会使政府面临财务风险。其可行性取决于采购成本、租赁条款以及州政府获得的价值。低于市场水平的租赁必须透明核算，并明确规定维护、保险、飞机使用率、付款违约以及运营商未能履约时的资产追回等事项。州有航空公司能否在建立它们的多届政府任期结束后继续生存，也是检验其可行性的另一项标准。Arume表示，可持续性取决于航空公司的设立是为了推动经济发展，还是服务于政治利益。他警告，出于政治原因创建的项目，可能会随着设立它们的州长离任而垮台。他说：“可行与否不是问题。我们真正应该问的是，成立州航空公司是为了政治原因，还是为了推动本州发展？‘如果是为了推动本州发展，我会说它是可行的。你可以把Ibom Air作为案例。‘如果是为了政治目的，那么随着设立它的州长任期结束，航空公司也会消亡。’”他将Ibom Air列为从连续多届政府延续中获益的航空公司案例。

金融专家对Enugu Air的可持续性提出疑虑，质疑其收入和更广泛的经济效益是否足以证明公共投资的合理性。他们认为，由于不公开经审计的财务报表，因此难以确定该航空公司的盈利能力、负债、运营成本、政府补贴和年度资金需求。《LEADERSHIP》的调查显示，恩古州政府为设立和扩张航空公司投入了大量资源，据报道在2025财年拨出410亿奈拉用于购买4架飞机。此前，时任交通委员会主任Obi Ozo博士在采访中透露，最初引进的3架Embraer飞机耗资约4000万美元，按当时汇率折合约620亿奈拉。包括飞机采购、运营、基础设施和相关投资在内，该航空公司的总支出仍不清楚。根据该州《2026年第一季度预算执行报告》，Enugu Air是州内主要内部收入来源，在此期间实现115.9亿奈拉收入。这家航空公司还与技术及行政岗位创造有关，包括该州一名本地人成为飞行员。最近开通的恩古至喀麦隆杜阿拉航线，预计将加强跨境贸易、休闲旅行以及东南地区侨民的交通连接，并支持该州将恩古打造为区域商业和旅游中心的雄心。

恩古州长Peter Mbah的政策与传播事务高级特别助理、Comrade Ken Ofoma在接受《LEADERSHIP》独家采访时，将该航空公司描述为一项盈利且可持续、持续扩张的投资。他说，恩古飞往英国Gatwick Airport的航班预计将于2026年12月开通，而飞往中国广州的航线则计划于2027年第一季度推出。Ofoma说：“因此，这家航空公司是州政府的标志性投资之一，因为它非常可持续，而且也在盈利。它是当今尼日利亚增长最快的航空公司之一。”Ofoma坚称，航空公司的运营并未削弱该州执行发展计划的能力。“航空公司的运营不会干扰该州项目和计划的执行。‘航空公司是综合交通改革的一部分，与3座超现代化公交总站相配套。所有这些都与旅游业发展衔接起来。正如你所知，目前该州正在开发大约6处旅游景点。’”

阿夸伊博姆州政府持有的Ibom Air旨在提供替代性收入来源、强化该州航空业并为当地年轻人创造就业机会。据该集团市场营销与传播经理Aniekan Essienette介绍，在近期从加拿大购入一架A220-300后，该航空公司拥有7架Bombardier CRJ900和3架Airbus A220-300，机队规模增至10架。它服务7个国内目的地，并运营包括飞往加纳阿克拉在内的国际航班。然而，由于不公开详细列示收入、支出、负债和政府支持情况的完整财务报表，因此难以独立评估其财务状况。熟悉其运营情况的知情人士告诉《LEADERSHIP》，该航空公司财务状况良好，并获得阿夸伊博姆州政府的充足资金支持。该州信息委员会主任Aniekan Umanah说，政府持续投资Ibom Air并扩展航空基础设施，包括一座维修、大修与翻修（MRO）设施，用于对国内和国际飞机进行例行检查和维修。他说，这些投资旨在强化航空公司，并将阿夸伊博姆打造成旅游、商业和投资目的地。

Umanah解释道：“在充分考虑所有风险因素的情况下，这家航空公司管理良好、维护到位，不负其使命，按照州长Umo Eno阁下的ARISE Agenda，让‘Destination Akwa Ibom’成为现实。‘本届政府上任以来一直投资Ibom Air，并扩建机场，同时配套建设维修、大修与翻修（MRO）设施，用于对本地和国际飞机进行例行检查和维修。‘其目标是让阿夸伊博姆州成为访客、游客和投资者的首选目的地。’”

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110304.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 임성호 강태우 기자 = LG에너지솔루션[373220]이 북미 에너지저장장치(ESS) 수요 확대에 힘입어 올해 4분기 매출이 전 분기 대비 약 10% 증가할 것으로 전망했다. 북미 ESS 사업에서는 현재 계획된 생산능력(캐파)을 기준으로 2028년까지 공급 물량 대부분이 확정된 가운데, 기존 생산시설의 가동률을 극대화하는 '선택과 집중' 전략을 통해 수익성 개선에 나선다는 방침이다. LG에너지솔루션은 북미 ESS 출하량 확대와 전기차(EV) 배터리 판매 증가 등에 힘입어 올해 3분기 매출 9조6천434억원, 영업이익 7천560억원을 기록했다고 3일 밝혔다. LG에너지솔루션은 이날 열린 3분기 실적발표 콘퍼런스콜에서 "4분기 ESS 출하량이 전 분기 대비 약 40% 증가할 것"이라고 관측했다. 유럽 고객사에 공급하는 고전압 미드니켈 파우치 배터리와 원통형 배터리 역시 견조한 출하 흐름을 유지할 것으로 전망했다. LG에너지솔루션은 "3분기부터 가동을 시작한 북미 합작법인(JV) 등의 영향으로 전사 매출은 3분기 대비 약 10% 성장할 것으로 본다"고 설명했다. 이날 LG에너지솔루션은 정정공시를 통해 올해 북미 생산보조금을 포함한 연간 매출 성장 목표를 전년 대비 35∼40%로 상향 조정했다. 기존 목표는 전년 대비 10% 중반∼20% 수준이었다. 또 북미 생산보조금을 포함한 올해 영업이익률은 한 자릿수 중반대를 달성하고, 설비투자(CAPEX·캐펙스)는 전년 대비 40% 이상 축소한다는 계획이다. 다만 3분기 일회성 요인 소멸과 혼다 합작법인의 ESS 생산능력 추가 가동에 따른 초기 고정비 부담으로 4분기 수익성은 일부 둔화가 불가피할 것이라는 게 회사의 설명이다. ESS는 확보된 수주 물량을 바탕으로 성장세를 이어가고, 소형 배터리는 차세대 원통형 제품인 46시리즈의 신규 수요처를 확대한다는 구상이다. 이와 함께 기존에 확보한 생산능력 내에서 운영 효율화와 가동률 극대화에 집중하고, 구조적 원가 경쟁력을 높여 수익성을 개선할 방침이다. 이창실 LG에너지솔루션 최고재무책임자(CFO) 부사장은 "제한된 자원으로 사업 운영의 효율성을 극대화하기 위해 '선택과 집중' 전략을 강화하겠다"고 밝혔다. LG에너지솔루션은 "현재 계획된 생산능력을 기준으로 2028년까지의 북미 ESS 물량은 대부분 확정된 상태"라며 "고객들과 그 이후 물량을 중심으로 수주 논의를 활발히 진행하고 있다"고 말했다. 주요 고객군으로는 기존 전력망 및 유틸리티 사업자뿐 아니라 인공지능(AI) 데이터센터 관련 고객과 글로벌 빅테크 기업들이 포함됐다. 특히 고객들의 예상 수요가 공급 가능한 생산능력을 웃돌고 있어 전략적 중요도가 높은 프로젝트를 중심으로 향후 생산 물량을 배분한다는 계획이다. 북미에서는 현지 생산 및 비금지외국기관(Non-PFE) 요건을 충족하는 ESS 수요에 대응하기 위해 올해 말까지 계획된 50GWh(기가와트시) 이상의 생산능력에 신규 각형 라인 등을 더해 내년 말 70GWh 이상 ESS 생산능력을 확보할 예정이다. 북미 첫 원통형 배터리 생산 거점인 애리조나 공장도 연말까지 가동 준비를 이어간다. LG에너지솔루션은 "미국의 PFE 소재 허용 비중이 올해 40%에서 내년 35% 이하로 낮아질 예정"이라며 "(이에 대응해) 양극재는 최근 계약한 국내 업체 외에도 복수의 Non-PFE 조달처를 확보했으며 음극재와 분리막, 전해액 등도 추가 공급처를 발굴 중"이라고 밝혔다. LG에너지솔루션의 부채비율은 지난해 3분기 125%에서 올해 3분기 171%로 상승했으며, 같은 기간 차입금 비율도 76%에서 98%로 높아졌다. LG에너지솔루션은 "주요 투자가 대부분 집행되면서 캐펙스 규모가 작년을 기점으로 유의미하게 감소하고 있으며, 향후 영업현금흐름 확대가 예상된다"며 "개선된 현금 흐름을 차입금 상환에 우선 활용하고 자산 유동화 등을 통한 추가 재원 확보도 병행할 방침"이라고 설명했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 11:44 송고 2026년11월03일 11시44분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110304.title_zh: 乐金新能源：第四季度营收增长10%……北美储能系统订单大部分将于2028年确认
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110304.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）林成浩、姜泰宇记者=LG新能源[373220]受北美能源存储系统（ESS）需求扩大推动，预计今年第四季度营收将较上一季度增长约10%。在北美ESS业务方面，以目前规划的产能（CAPA）计算，到2028年的大部分供应量已经敲定。公司方针是通过最大限度提高现有生产设施稼动率的“选择与集中”战略，改善盈利能力。LG新能源3日表示，受北美ESS出货量扩大和电动车（EV）电池销量增长等因素推动，今年第三季度实现营收9.6434万亿韩元、营业利润7560亿韩元。LG新能源在当天举行的第三季度业绩说明电话会上表示，“第四季度ESS出货量将较上一季度增长约40%”。向欧洲客户供应的高压中镍袋式电池和圆柱电池也预计将保持稳健出货。LG新能源解释道，“受北美合资企业（JV）等从第三季度开始投产等因素影响，预计全公司营收将较第三季度增长约10%”。当天，LG新能源通过更正公告，将包括北美生产补贴在内的全年营收增长目标从同比增长10%中段至20%的水平，上调至同比增长35%至40%。公司计划，包括北美生产补贴在内的今年营业利润率将达个位数中段水平，资本支出（CAPEX）较去年缩减40%以上。不过，公司解释称，第三季度一次性因素消失，以及北美合资企业ESS新增产能投产后带来的初期固定成本负担，将不可避免地导致第四季度盈利能力有所放缓。ESS将凭借已 확보的订单量延续增长势头，小型电池则计划通过扩大下一代圆柱产品46系列的新客户群来拓展需求。同时，公司将专注于在现有产能范围内提高运营效率和稼动率，并通过提升结构性成本竞争力改善盈利能力。LG新能源首席财务官（CFO）李昌实副董事长表示，“为在有限资源下最大限度提高业务运营效率，将加强‘选择与集中’战略”。LG新能源称，“以目前规划的产能计算，到2028年的北美ESS供应量大部分已经确定”，并表示“正以客户及其后续需求量为中心，积极开展订单磋商”。主要客户群除了现有电网及公用事业运营商外，还包括人工智能（AI）数据中心相关客户和全球大型科技企业。尤其是由于客户预期需求超过可供产能，公司计划今后优先向具有重要战略意义的项目分配供应量。在北美，为满足当地生产及符合非受关注外国实体（Non-PFE）要求的ESS需求，公司计划在年底前将规划中的50GWh（吉瓦时）以上产能与新建方形电池产线等相结合，确保到明年底具备70GWh以上ESS产能。北美首个圆柱电池生产基地亚利桑那工厂也将继续推进投产准备，直至年底。LG新能源表示，“美国允许从PFE来源采购的比例预计将从今年的40%降至明年的35%以下”，并称“（为应对这一情况），除近期签约的韩国供应商外，正极材料已确保多家Non-PFE采购渠道，负极材料、隔膜、电解液等也在发掘更多供应商”。LG新能源的负债率从去年第三季度的125%升至今年第三季度的171%，同期借款比率也从76%升至98%。LG新能源解释道，“随着主要投资项目大多得到执行，资本支出规模较去年出现明显下降，预计未来经营现金流将扩大”，并表示“将优先使用改善后的现金流偿还借款，同时通过资产证券化等方式同步筹集额外资金”。请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、再发布及用于AI学习和应用> 2026/11/03 11:44发稿 2026年11月03日11时44分发稿

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110309.title: 통일부, '北 바이낸스 해킹' 지목에 "상황 파악이 우선"
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110309.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 하채림 기자 = 통일부는 미국의 가상자산거래소 바이낸스를 공격해 8조원대 가상자산을 탈취한 주체로 북한이 지목된 데 대해 "정확한 상황을 파악하는 것이 우선"이라는 신중한 입장을 보였다. 통일부 당국자는 3일 정부서울청사에서 취재진과 만난 자리에서 북한이 바이낸스 해킹 공격의 배후라는 미국 수사당국의 발표에 동의하냐는 질문에 "FBI(연방수사국)에서 얘기한 내용으로, 우리 관계기관 간에 정보가 공유된 것은 없다"고 답변했다. 국제사회의 추가 대북 제재에 동참할 것인지 질문에도 "상황 파악을 토대로 관계부처와 대응 방안을 검토하는 것이 맞다"며 "현시점에서 그(추가 제재) 문제를 언급할 필요성이 없다"고 덧붙였다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110309.summary_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）记者河彩林＝韩国统一部对朝鲜被指为攻击美国加密货币交易所币安并窃取8万亿韩元规模虚拟资产的幕后黑手一事，表现出“先准确掌握情况”的谨慎立场。统一部负责人3日在政府首尔厅接受记者采访，被问是否认同美国调查机关关于朝鲜是币安黑客攻击幕后黑手的说法时回答称：“这是联邦调查局（FBI）所说的内容，我们的相关机构之间并未共享信息。”当被问是否将参与国际社会对朝追加制裁时，他又说：“应基于对情况的掌握，与相关部委研究应对方案。目前没有必要提及这一问题。”

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110309.title_zh: 朝鲜统一部就“朝鲜策划币安黑客攻击”一事称“掌握情况优先”
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110309.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）河彩琳记者＝统一部就美国将攻击美国虚拟资产交易所Binance、窃取8万亿韩元规模虚拟资产的幕后主体认定为朝鲜一事，表现出“准确掌握情况优先”的谨慎立场。统一部有关人士3日在政府首尔厅办公室接受记者采访，被问是否同意美国执法机关关于朝鲜是Binance黑客攻击幕后黑手的说法时回答：“这是FBI（联邦调查局）所说的内容，我们的相关机构之间没有共享相关信息。”当被问是否将参与国际社会对朝鲜追加制裁时，他表示：“应该以掌握情况为基础，相关主管部门共同研究应对方案。”他补充道：“就目前情况而言，没有必要提及（追加制裁）问题。”此前，朝鲜当天通过官营媒体刊登朝鲜劳动党中央部长金英正的谈话，反驳自身被列为Binance黑客攻击幕后黑手的说法，称这是“严重的政治挑衅”，并警告称：“针对美国的敌对态度，我们有必要从多个方面重新审视一些问题。”随着此次网络攻击造成的国际影响扩大，金额达到8万亿韩元左右，朝鲜似乎已严肃认识此事并提高调门表明立场。据分析，统一部当天就金英正谈话表示，如果朝鲜考虑重启韩美对话，就会阻止非法网络活动成为新的焦点，同时向美国施压，要求撤回“对朝敌视政策”。对此可利用KakaoTalk okjebo咨询。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载和再发布，禁止用于AI学习及使用。2026/11/03 11:44发布，2026年11月3日11时44分发布（首尔=韩联社）朴永锡记者＝据加密货币专业媒体CoinDesk和Cointelegraph等1日（当地时间）报道，上月29日Binance黑客事件中被窃走的比特币共1万8,270枚，按每枚7万8,500美元的价格计算，价值约14亿美元（约1万8,701亿韩元）。zeroground@yna.co.kr X（推特）@yonhap_graphics Instagram @yonhapgraphics

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: Plug-in hybrid SUV combines comfort and efficiency with aggressive pricing Starting BYD Korea's Sealion 6 DM-i plug-in hybrid SUV, the first thing that stood out was the exceptional quietness of its cabin. Driving through city streets and along highways, the SUV felt more like a mid-size luxury sedan than a family-oriented SUV. In the name Sealion 6 DM-i, DM-i stands for “Dual Mode-intelligent,” BYD’s proprietary plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) technology, which powers the vehicle's long-range drive. Its cabin remained remarkably quiet at low speeds, when the electric motor does most of the work. Minor vibrations were barely noticeable, while the suspension softened the impact of speed bumps and uneven pavement. The result was a relaxed, composed ride that made long-distance driving less tiring. On a roughly 100-kilometer round trip between Seoul and Paju, Gyeonggi Province, the SUV proved remarkably easy on the driver, with minimal fatigue and impressive fuel efficiency that exceeded expectations. The Sealion 6 DM-i is not built to deliver the explosive acceleration or sharp handling of a performance electric vehicle (EV). Its appeal lies elsewhere: comfortable cruising, low running costs and the freedom to travel long distances without constantly searching for a charging station. BYD Korea claims a combined driving range approaching 1,000 kilometers, making efficiency one of the SUV's strongest selling points. Its 18.3-kilowatt-hour battery provides up to 70 kilometers of all-electric driving, enough to cover many daily commutes without using gasoline. When the battery charge falls below 25 percent, the gasoline engine can generate electricity to sustain operation. That flexibility addresses one of the biggest inconveniences of owning a pure EV. Drivers can charge at home and use electric power for shorter trips, while relying on the hybrid system for longer journeys. The powertrain pairs a 1.5-liter turbocharged gasoline engine, producing 130 horsepower and 220 newton-meters of torque, with an electric motor. The SUV accelerates from zero to 100 kilometers per hour in 8.3 seconds — a figure seen as fairly unremarkable — but this is still enough for customers who prioritize smooth, predictable progress over outright speed. Pricing, however, may prove its most disruptive feature. Starting at 37.5 million won ($27,000), the Sealion 6 DM-i undercuts many plug-in hybrid rivals, which typically occupy price brackets above 60 million won. BYD's vertically integrated manufacturing, spanning batteries to finished vehicles, helps explain its ability to offer the SUV at such an aggressive price. Seven airbags and driver-assistance features, including adaptive cruise control, lane-departure prevention and rear cross-traffic alerts, come standard. For buyers seeking the refinement of a quiet sedan, the flexibility of a hybrid and the range for extended road trips, the Sealion 6 DM-i makes a compelling case — particularly at a price that puts plug-in hybrid ownership within reach of a much wider market

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: 比亚迪韩国海狮6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV以激进定价兼顾舒适性与效率。试驾BYD Korea的Sealion 6 DM-i插电式混合动力SUV时，最先给人留下深刻印象的是其座舱出色的静谧性。行驶在城市街道和高速公路上，这款SUV给人的感觉更像是中型豪华轿车，而非家庭取向的SUV。在Sealion 6 DM-i这一名称中，DM-i代表“智能双模式”（Dual Mode-intelligent），这是比亚迪自主研发的插电式混合动力电动车（PHEV）技术，为车辆的长续航行驶提供动力。低速行驶时，大部分工作由电动机完成，车内始终保持非凡安静。轻微振动几乎难以察觉，悬架也缓和了减速带和不平整路面带来的冲击。由此带来的乘坐体验从容沉稳，让长途驾驶不易疲劳。在京畿道首尔与坡州市之间约100公里的往返行程中，这款SUV让驾驶者感到格外轻松，疲劳程度极低，燃油经济性也超出预期。Sealion 6 DM-i并非为追求性能电动车（EV）那种爆发式加速或灵敏操控而打造。它的吸引力另有其处：舒适的巡航体验、低使用成本，以及无需不断寻找充电站便可长途旅行的自由。BYD Korea声称，该车综合续航里程接近1,000公里，使效率成为这款SUV最突出的卖点之一。其18.3千瓦时电池可支持最长70公里的纯电行驶，足以应对许多日常通勤，全程无需使用汽油。当电池电量降至25 percent以下时，汽油发动机可持续发电以维持车辆运行。这种灵活性解决了拥有纯电动车所面临的最大不便之一。驾驶者可以居家充电，短途出行使用电力，而长途旅行则依靠混合动力系统。这套动力系统将最大输出130马力、220牛·米扭矩的1.5升涡轮增压汽油发动机与电动机结合。该SUV从零加速至每小时100公里需8.3秒——这一成绩只能算中规中矩——但对于更看重平顺、可预期加速表现而非极致速度的消费者而言，仍然足够。不过，定价可能成为其最具颠覆性的特点。Sealion 6 DM-i起售价为3,750万韩元（$27,000），低于许多插电式混合动力竞品，后者的售价通常处于6,000万韩元以上的区间。比亚迪从电池到整车的垂直一体化生产模式，有助于解释该SUV为何能够以如此激进的价格推出。7个安全气囊以及一系列驾驶辅助功能均为标配，包括自适应巡航控制、车道偏离防系统和车后方交叉交通警报。对于希望拥有安静轿车般的精致感、混合动力车的灵活性以及长途自驾续航能力的消费者而言，Sealion 6 DM-i具有很强的说服力，尤其是其价格让插电式混合动力汽车进入了更广泛的市场。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国周二公布的数据显示，韩国10月消费者价格较一年前上涨2.8%。尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据与统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Korea's consumer prices rose 2.8 percent in October from a year earlier, data showed Tuesday, as agricultural product prices continued to decline despite energy costs remaining elevated. According to data from the Ministry of Data and Statistics, consumer price growth eased to 2.8 percent in October from 2.9 percent in September and 3.1 percent in August. The data ministry said petroleum products' prices advanced 14.9 percent year-on-year in October, contributing 0.56 percentage point to the month's year-on-year inflation rate. It was the sharpest growth since 15.5 percent posted in July. In detail, diesel prices jumped 19.7 percent year-on-year in October, while gasoline prices increased a sharp 11.6 percent. The report showed that prices of industrial products overall rose 4.4 percent year-on-year in October due to higher global energy prices, with those of mobile phones and computers climbing 10.8 percent and 26.2 percent, respectively. Prices of imported automobiles, on the other hand, fell 3.9 percent over the same period. In addition, prices of agricultural, livestock and fishery products fell 1.7 percent over the same period, the findings showed, lowering the overall inflation rate by 0.14 percentage point. It marked the third consecutive month of an year-on-year decline. Prices of apples, napa cabbages and cucumbers fell 13.4 percent, 44.3 percent and 39.5 percent, respectively. Those of domestically produced beef, however, rose 9.1 percent. The service sector's prices moved up 2.7 percent, led by higher insurance premiums and overseas package tour prices, which increased 13.4 percent and 11.5 percent, respectively. Dining-out prices climbed 2.9 percent year-on-year in October, marking the highest increase since February, when they also increased 2.9 percent, and contributing 0.42 percentage point to the overall inflation rate. Prices of electricity, gas and water went up 0.4 percent over the same period. Core inflation, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, stood at 2.8 percent year-on-year in October
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 10月消费者价格上涨2.8%，连续第二个月维持在2%区间
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国消费者价格10月同比上涨2.8%，数据周二显示，尽管能源成本仍处高位，但农产品价格继续下降。韩国数据统计部数据显示，消费者价格涨幅从9月的2.9%和8月的3.1%放缓至10月的2.8%。数据部表示，10月石油产品价格同比上涨14.9%，对当月同比通胀率贡献0.56个百分点。这是7月录得15.5%以来的最大涨幅。分项来看，10月柴油价格同比飙升19.7%，汽油价格也大幅上涨11.6%。报告显示，受全球能源价格上涨影响，10月工业品价格整体同比上涨4.4%，其中手机和计算机价格分别上涨10.8%和26.2%。另一方面，进口汽车价格同期下降3.9%。此外，结果显示，农产品、畜产品和渔业产品价格同期下降1.7%，使总体通胀率降低0.14个百分点。这标志着同比价格连续第三个月下降。苹果、大白菜和黄瓜价格分别下跌13.4%、44.3%和39.5%。不过，韩国国产牛肉价格上涨9.1%。服务部门价格上涨2.7%，主要受保险费和海外套餐旅游价格上涨推动，两者分别上涨13.4%和11.5%。10月外出就餐价格同比上涨2.9%，创下2月以来的最大涨幅，当时涨幅同样为2.9%，并对总体通胀率贡献0.42个百分点。电力、燃气和水价同期上涨0.4%。剔除波动较大的食品和能源价格的核心通胀率10月同比维持在2.8%

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: SEATTLE — With the Trump administration stepping up its crackdown on noncitizen voting ahead of Tuesday's midterm elections, some Korean green card holders are worried that receiving election ballots they never requested could land them in immigration trouble. Across online forums and social media discussions, including Korean-American communities, green card holders have shared accounts of receiving ballots or voter-registration materials despite not being U.S. citizens. "I'm a green card holder, but ballots come to my house every time," one user wrote. Another said she and her husband, both green card holders, had received jury summonses, and that her husband had also received election-related mail. The accounts have prompted discussions about how noncitizens end up receiving election materials and whether mistakes involving voter registration could jeopardize their green cards or future citizenship applications. Some users expressed concern that they may have been registered without realizing it, while others questioned how permanent residents could be unaware that only U.S. citizens are allowed to vote. The concerns come as federal authorities pursue criminal cases against green card holders accused of voting illegally. On Oct. 19, the Justice Department announced charges against 28 permanent residents in California for offenses including fraudulent voter registration, unlawful voting and false statements during naturalization proceedings. Among them was Jennifer Jung, a 31-year-old Korean woman with Canadian citizenship living in San Diego, according to Korean-language broadcaster Radio Korea. Federal prosecutors allege that Jung falsely claimed to be a U.S. citizen when registering to vote, cast a ballot in the November 2024 election and later made false statements about her voting history during a naturalization interview. The cases have also raised questions about California's voter registration system, which automatically registers eligible applicants during Department of Motor Vehicles transactions unless they opt out. State officials say applicants who indicate they are ineligible are not registered through the system. However, California has previously acknowledged cases of people being registered erroneously. Receiving election-related mail does not necessarily mean someone is registered to vote, and simply receiving a ballot is not a voting offense. But knowingly making a false claim of U.S. citizenship or voting illegally can have serious immigration consequences. The consequences depend on the circumstances, including how the person became registered, whether a ballot was cast and whether any false claim of citizenship was made. California allows people who were registered by mistake to cancel their registration through their county elections office, although cancellation does not necessarily eliminate potential immigration consequences from past violations
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.title_zh: 美国严打投票问题令持有韩国绿卡的选民担心收到非预期选票
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 西雅图——随着特朗普政府加强打击非公民投票，并赶在周二中期选举前展开行动，一些持有韩国绿卡的人士担心，收到自己从未申请过的选票可能会给他们带来移民方面的麻烦。在包括韩裔美国人社群在内的网络论坛和社交媒体讨论中，持有绿卡的人士讲述了自己尽管并非美国公民，却收到选票或选民登记材料的经历。一名用户写道：“我是绿卡持有者，但每次都有选票寄到我家。”另一名用户表示，她和丈夫都持有绿卡，却收到了陪审团传票，她丈夫还收到了与选举有关的邮件。这些经历引发了讨论：非公民为何会收到选举材料，以及选民登记方面的失误是否可能危及他们的绿卡或未来的公民身份申请。一些用户担心自己可能在不知情的情况下被登记为选民，另一些人则质疑，永久居民怎么会不知道只有美国公民才有权投票。联邦当局目前正对被控非法投票的绿卡持有者追究刑事责任。10月19日，美国司法部宣布对加利福尼亚州的28名永久 residents 提出指控，罪名包括欺诈性选民登记、非法投票以及在入籍程序中作虚假陈述。据韩语广播机构Korea Radio报道，被指控者中包括31岁的韩国裔女性Jennifer Jung，她拥有加拿大国籍，居住在圣迭戈。联邦检察官称，Jung在登记投票时虚假声称自己是美国公民，在2024年11月选举中投了票，并在之后的入籍面谈中就自己的投票记录作出虚假陈述。这些案件还引发了人们对加利福尼亚州选民登记系统的疑问。该系统在机动车管理局办理业务时会自动登记符合条件的申请人，除非申请人选择退出。州官员表示，在系统中表明自己不符合资格的申请人不会被登记。不过，加利福尼亚州此前曾承认发生过一些人被错误登记的个案。收到与选举有关的邮件并不一定意味着某人已登记为选民，而仅仅收到选票也不构成投票违法行为。但明知而虚假声称拥有美国国籍或非法投票，可能造成严重的移民后果。具体后果取决于多种情况，包括此人如何被登记、是否实际投票，以及是否曾虚假声称拥有美国国籍。加利福尼亚州允许被错误登记的人通过所在县的选举办公室取消登记，但取消登记并不一定能消除过去违法行为可能产生的移民后果……

The third meeting of the Korea-Bulgaria Joint Economic Committee was held in Sofia on Monday (local time), co-chaired by Park Jong-han, deputy minister for economic affairs, and Krasimir Yakimov, the Bulgarian deputy economic minister, according to the ministry. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary: Political appointees and career diplomats each have their own strengths. Which group is better suited to representing Korea at overseas missions: career diplomats or political appointees? If a diplomatic post is politically sensitive or strategically important, political appointees may have an advantage over career diplomats because they can leverage their personal ties with the president to address urgent and contentious issues.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.summary_zh: 政治任命人员与职业外交官各有优势。哪一类人更适合在海外使团代表韩国：职业外交官还是政治任命人员？如果某个外交职位政治敏感或具有战略意义，政治任命人员可能比职业外交官更具优势，因为他们可以利用与总统的个人关系，妥善处理紧急且存在争议的问题。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body: In October, a business gala reception was held in one of the 10 largest cities of the United States. Forgive me for not providing further details about the event or the city where it took place. In this column, everything — from the attendees and their names and genders to other details that might help identify the person I am referring to — will remain anonymous to protect their identities. The only exception is the gender of my friend, who shared the story with me. My friend, who was also invited as a VIP guest, said she approached the Korean diplomat to share something she considered important. According to her, the diplomat repeatedly clapped with both hands raised above the head. “It was an invitation-only event, and all the attendees were VIPs affiliated with the host organization. The Korean diplomat’s way of clapping bothered me throughout the event. I thought the behavior was awkward and highly undiplomatic,” she said. She added that the diplomat also seemed to be unfamiliar with table etiquette, randomly using forks while eating the full-course dinner served that evening. My friend acknowledged that such etiquette might seem like a minor issue to ordinary people, but she took it seriously because the diplomat was representing Korea at the event. It would be inappropriate to judge diplomats and their professional performance solely by their table manners. Nevertheless, in diplomatic circles, such behavior can become a subject of gossip, reflecting not only on the diplomat but also on the country they represent. Back home, once such an episode becomes public, it can give critics further ammunition to challenge the practice of appointing non-career diplomats in key foreign postings. The diplomat in question was a political appointee with no prior diplomatic experience before assuming the post. Before leaving Korea, first-time ambassadors and consuls general are required to undergo three weeks of intensive training. During this period, they learn what it means to serve as heads of mission and what is expected of them in their overseas postings. Diplomatic etiquette, protocol and leadership are among the subjects covered in the three-week program. Political appointees to overseas missions came under fire during the National Assembly's annual audit of Korea's Permanent Mission to the United Nations in New York on Oct. 13. Independent lawmaker Han Dong-hoon criticized President Lee Jae Myung's choice of Cha Ji-hoon, who currently serves as Korea's ambassador to the U.N., questioning Cha's suitability for the position. Han described the lawyer-turned-envoy as an "amateur" who had landed the prestigious diplomatic post through his personal ties to the president. "Mr. Ambassador, you have no prior diplomatic experience. Would it have been possible for an amateur like you to rise to a position previously held by highly trained diplomatic professionals if not for your personal ties to the president?" Han asked. Cha responded that since arriving in New York last year, he had met many ambassadors who, like him, were political appointees. Although Han did not elaborate on why he considered Cha an amateur, his subsequent question offered a clue as to his belief that Cha is unqualified to represent Korea at the United Nations. "Is your English good enough to communicate freely with others without difficulty?" the lawmaker asked. Cha replied that he had been communicating properly in English. The spoils system has drawn criticism since Lee appointed his lawyer, Cha, to the key diplomatic post in September last year. As Han pointed out, Cha's lack of experience in foreign policy and diplomacy was a major source of controversy surrounding his appointment. Political appointees and career diplomats each have their own strengths. Thanks to their professional training at the foreign ministry and experience in previous overseas postings, career diplomats have an insider's understanding of how diplomacy works. Political appointees, by contrast, generally enjoy relatively easier access to their appointing authority — the head of state — because of their personal ties. This can lead senior officials in host countries to view them as potential conduits to the highest levels of government. However, both groups also have their respective shortcomings. Career diplomats, in general, tend to rely heavily on diplomatic rhetoric and well-honed communication skills when interacting with others. Conversations with them can sometimes leave their counterparts wondering: So what? Political appointees, meanwhile, may behave undiplomatically, as illustrated by the incident at the gala reception, making themselves — and sometimes their countries — a subject of gossip because of their unfamiliarity with diplomatic etiquette. Which group is better suited to representing Korea at overseas missions: career diplomats or political appointees? The answer depends on the nature of the mission to which they are assigned. If a diplomatic post is politically sensitive or strategically important, political appointees may have an advantage over career diplomats because they can leverage their personal ties with the president to address urgent and contentious issues. If bilateral relations with the host country are stable and free of particularly sensitive issues, career diplomats may be better suited to the job. Therefore, the real question the president should ask is not whether a candidate is a career diplomat or a political appointee. Rather, the focus should be on whether the person is capable of getting the job done. Some people have stellar résumés, but their actual performance in the workplace fails to live up to their credentials. In this regard, I believe there is something wrong with Han's criteria for distinguishing diplomatic professionals from amateurs. Although he did not explicitly spell out his standards, his questions suggest that foreign language proficiency and prior diplomatic experience are two essential qualifications for an ideal candidate for a diplomatic post. By his reasoning, career diplomats who speak English fluently would be the perfect candidates. While covering the diplomatic circuit in Seoul about a decade ago, I met many diplomats, both career officials and political appointees. As Han suggested, foreign language proficiency matters, and prior diplomatic experience is important. But these qualities alone rarely make a diplomat great. What matters most is dedication and a commitment to getting things done. Those whose actual job performance falls short of their credentials should be the first to be excluded from consideration for diplomatic appointments. Finding capable heads of mission to represent Korea overseas can be as difficult as finding a diamond in the rough. This helps explain why the search for suitable candidates so often ends in disappointment. Nevertheless, the president must keep trying
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.title_zh: 职业外交官与政治任命人员：什么样的人才是一名优秀外交官？
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/opinion/202.body_zh: 10月，美国十大城市之一举办了一场商务晚宴招待会。请原谅我不再提供有关这场活动或举办城市的进一步细节。在本专栏中，从出席者及其姓名和性别，到其他可能有助于识别我所指之人的细节，所有信息都将匿名处理，以保护他们的身份。唯一的例外是我的那位朋友的性别，她曾向我讲述此事。我的朋友也受邀作为贵宾出席，她说自己曾主动接近那名韩国外交官，想与其分享某件她认为重要的事情。据她表示，那名外交官把双手举过头顶，不停鼓掌。她说：“这是一场仅限受邀者参加的活动，所有出席者都是与主办机构有关联的贵宾。整个活动期间，那名韩国外交官鼓掌的方式一直让我感到不适。我认为这种行为既尴尬，也极不符合外交礼节。”她还补充说，那名外交官似乎也不熟悉餐桌礼仪，在当晚供应的全套正餐中用餐时，随意使用叉子。我的朋友承认，在普通人看来，这类礼仪可能只是小事，但她认真对待此事，因为那名外交官当时正代表韩国出席活动。仅凭餐桌礼仪就评判外交官及其职业表现并不恰当。然而，在外交圈中，这类行为可能成为谈资，不仅会影响外交官本人，也会影响其所代表的国家。类似事件一旦在国内公开，批评者便可进一步借题发挥，质疑在重要外交职位上任命非职业外交官的惯例。相关外交官是一名政治任命人士，在担任该职位前没有任何外交经验。在离开韩国前，首次担任大使和总领事的人员必须接受为期三周的强化培训。在此期间，他们要学习担任驻外机构负责人意味着什么，以及海外任职对自己的要求。外交礼节、礼仪规范和领导能力均在这三周培训课程的涵盖范围之内。10月13日，韩国常驻联合国代表团在纽约接受国会年度审计时，驻外机构的政治任命人士受到批评。独立议员韩东勋批评总统李在明任命现任韩国驻联合国大使车寄勋，质疑车寄勋是否适合担任该职位。韩东勋将这位由律师转任外交官的人士形容为“外行人”，称他凭借与总统的私人关系获得了这一重要外交职位。韩东勋问道：“大使先生，您没有任何外交经验。如果不是凭借与总统的私人关系，像您这样的外行人有可能升任此前由受过严格训练的专业外交人士担任的职位吗？”车寄勋回应称，自去年抵达纽约以来，他已见过许多与他一样由政治任命而来的大使。韩东勋没有进一步说明自己为何认为车寄勋是外行人，但他随后提出的问题却透露出其看法：车寄勋没有资格代表韩国常驻联合国。“您的英语是否足以与他人自如交流，不会感到困难？”这名议员问道。车寄勋回答说，他一直能够用英语恰当沟通。自李在明去年9月任命自己的律师车寄勋担任这一重要外交职位以来，“ spoils system”（分赃制）一直受到批评。正如韩东勋所指出的，车寄勋缺乏外交和外交事务经验，是围绕其任命产生争议的主要原因。政治任命人士和职业外交官各有长处。凭借在外交部门接受的专业训练以及此前在海外任职的经历，职业外交官对 diplomacy（外交）如何运作有内部人士式的理解。相比之下，政治任命人士凭借私人关系，通常更容易接触到任命他们的权力机构，即国家元首。这可能使东道国的高级官员把他们视为通往政府最高层的潜在渠道。然而，两类人士也各有缺点。职业外交官通常在与他人交流时，过度依赖外交辞令和经过磨炼的沟通技巧。与他们交谈有时会让对方产生一种“然后呢？”的感受。与此同时，正如这次招待会事件所显示的，政治任命人士可能作出不符合外交礼节的行为，并因不熟悉外交礼节而让自己、有时甚至让自己的国家成为谈资。哪类人士更适合代表韩国常驻海外机构：职业外交官还是政治任命人士？答案取决于他们所执行任务的具体性质。如果某一外交职位在政治上敏感或具有战略意义，政治任命人士可能比职业外交官更具优势，因为他们可以利用与总统的私人关系，处理紧迫且存在争议的问题。如果韩国与东道国的双边关系稳定，且没有特别敏感的问题，职业外交官可能更适合这份工作。因此，总统真正应该提出的问题，不是候选人属于职业外交官还是政治任命人士，而应关注此人是否有能力完成工作。有些人的履历光彩夺目，但其实际工作表现却未能达到履历所显示的水平。在这方面，我认为韩东勋区分专业外交人士与外行人士的标准存在问题。尽管他没有明确阐明自己的衡量标准，但他提出的问题表明，外语能力与先前外交经验是理想外交职位候选人的两项基本资格。按照他的逻辑，英语流利的职业外交官将是完美人选。大约十年前，我在首尔跑外交新闻时，接触过许多外交官，既有职业官员，也有政治任命人士。正如韩东勋所说，外语能力确实重要，先前的外交经验也很重要。但仅凭这些 qualities（素质）很少能让一名外交官成为卓越外交官。最重要的是奉献精神，以及把事情做好的决心。那些实际工作表现未能达到自身履历水平的人，应当首先被排除在外交任命人选之外。寻找能够代表韩国的优秀驻外机构负责人，可能如同从粗砺原石中寻找钻石一样困难。这也有助于解释为何寻找合适候选人的过程往往以失望告终。尽管如此，总统仍必须继续努力……

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea prepares launch of new SMR review system this month: nuclear watchdog chief
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: In response to such shifts in energy demands, Korea is set to introduce a preliminary review system designed to streamline the commercial development and deployment of SMRs starting later this month. With less than a month to go ahead of the system's launch, around ten companies — both from home and abroad — have expressed their intent to apply, with some considering making a submission immediately after the system takes effect, the head of the country's nuclear watchdog said.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 为应对能源需求变化，韩国计划从本月晚些时候起推出一套初步审查制度，旨在简化小型模块化反应堆（SMR）的商业开发和部署。该国核监管机构负责人表示，在距离制度启动不到一个月之际，已有约10家公司——包括来自国内和海外的企业——表达申请意向，其中一些公司正考虑制度生效后立即提交申请。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: Small modular reactors (SMRs) have emerged as an important, carbon-free energy source in the era of artificial intelligence (AI), where the explosive growth of data centers requires an unprecedented amount of stable power. In response to such shifts in energy demands, Korea is set to introduce a preliminary review system designed to streamline the commercial development and deployment of SMRs starting later this month. The system will allow SMR developers to undergo safety and design verifications before formal licensing. It has already been adopted in countries such as the United States and Canada. With less than a month to go ahead of the system's launch, around ten companies — both from home and abroad — have expressed their intent to apply, with some considering making a submission immediately after the system takes effect, the head of the country's nuclear watchdog said. "There are a few SMR developers saying they will apply as soon as the preliminary review system is launched," Choi Won-ho, the head of the Nuclear Safety and Security Commission (NSSC), said in an interview with Yonhap News Agency on Thursday. They include BEES Inc., a Korean SMR developer, TerraPower from the U.S. and Saltfoss Energy from Denmark, according to Choi. In February, Korea announced its roadmap to establish a regulatory framework for SMRs. Under the scheme, the NSSC will overhaul existing safety standards in phases by 2030 to include nuclear reactors of various designs and purposes. "The system can ease uncertainties surrounding regulatory reviews for companies, while also allowing institutions to understand new technologies from a regulatory perspective earlier on," Choi said. Choi noted that his agency is actively participating in global projects on SMR regulations, including those led by the International Atomic Energy Agency. It is also in discussions with countries like the U.S. and Canada, which already have experience in the authorization of such reactors. "It's important to ensure international consistency in our SMR regulations." Establishing a domestic regulatory framework is not just important for deployment at home, but for Korea's nuclear export strategy, the watchdog chief said. In 2009, a Korea-led consortium won a project to export four nuclear reactors using its homegrown technology to the United Arab Emirates (UAE), all of which have commenced commercial operations as of 2024. This was followed by another project to build two reactors in the Czech Republic's Dukovany, signed last year. "To export nuclear reactors, the sharing and transferring of expertise on safety regulation to the host country ... is as important as the nuclear technology itself," Choi said. Most recently, the NSSC is discussing areas of cooperation with Vietnam, which officially restarted its nuclear power program in 2024. "Vietnam is requesting our support in the establishment of a safety regulatory framework and the training and education of related personnel," he explained. On the timeline regarding the lifespan extension review of seven aging reactors, Choi said he expects the commission to review Hanbit units 1 and 2 within the first half of 2027 and Hanul units 1 and 2 by the second half of next year. A total of 10 nuclear reactors were up for lifespan extension reviews following a request from the Korea Hydro and Nuclear Power Co. (KHNP), the state-run nuclear plant operator. The NSSC has since approved a 10-year extension for three pressurized water reactors that have been in operation for over 40 years — Kori units 2, 3 and 4 — located in the country's southeastern coast. The nuclear watchdog, meanwhile, vowed to continue its monitoring activities regarding Japan's continued release of water from the disabled Fukushima nuclear power plant. "We have been analyzing the effects of the water release at 78 points," he said. "The NSSC plans to continue the inspection of not only our territorial waters, but the monitoring of activities carried out by Japan."
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 韩国核监管机构负责人：韩国准备于本月启动新的小型模块化反应堆审查制度
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 在人工智能时代，随着数据中心的爆发式增长需要前所未有的稳定电力供应，小型模块化反应堆（SMR）已成为一种重要的无碳能源。为应对能源需求的这般变化，韩国将从本月晚些时候起引入预审制度，以简化SMR的商业开发和部署。该制度将允许SMR开发商在正式获得许可前接受安全性和设计验证。美国、加拿大等国家已经采用这一制度。韩国核安全与安保委员会（NSSC）负责人表示，在该制度启动前不到一个月的时间里，国内外约10家公司已表示有意申请，其中一些正考虑制度生效后立即提交申请。NSSC负责人崔元浩（Choi Won-ho）周四接受韩联社采访时说：“有几家SMR开发商表示，预审制度启动后就会立即申请。”据崔元浩介绍，申请方包括韩国SMR开发商BEES Inc.、美国TerraPower和丹麦Saltfoss Energy。今年2月，韩国宣布了建立SMR监管框架的路线图。根据该方案，NSSC将分阶段全面修订现行安全标准，到2030年将不同设计和用途的核反应堆纳入其中。崔元浩说：“该制度既能减轻企业在监管审查方面的不确定性，也能让监管机构更早从监管角度了解新技术。”崔元浩表示，该机构正积极参与SMR监管相关的全球项目，包括由国际原子能机构牵头的项目；目前还正与已获得此类反应堆许可经验的美国、加拿大等国家进行磋商。“确保SMR监管与国际规范保持一致十分重要。”这位监管机构负责人说，建立国内监管框架不仅对韩国在国内部署SMR至关重要，也是韩国核能出口战略的一部分。2009年，由韩国牵头的一个联合体中标了向阿拉伯联合酋长国（UAE）出口4台采用韩国自主技术的核反应堆项目，截至2024年，这些反应堆均已投入商业运行。此后，韩国又于去年签署了在捷克Dukovany建设2台反应堆的项目合同。崔元浩说：“要出口核反应堆，向东道国共享并转让安全监管方面的专业知识，与核技术本身同样重要。”最近，NSSC正与正式重启核能计划的越南商讨合作领域。他解释道：“越南请求我们协助建立安全监管框架，并开展相关人员的培训和教育工作。”谈及7台老化反应堆延寿审查的时间表，崔元浩预计，委员会将在2027年上半年审查韩빛1号和2号机组，并在明年下半年审查韩蔚1号和2号机组。在韩国水电与核电公司（KHNP）提出请求后，共有10台核反应堆接受了延寿审查。该国有核电站运营商的申请之后，NSSC已批准对位于韩国东南沿海、运行超过40年的3台压水堆延长10年寿命，分别是龟尾2号、3号和4号机组。与此同时，NSSC承诺将继续监督日本持续排放福岛核电站受损核电站污水的情况。他说：“我们一直在分析污水排放在78个地点造成的影响。”“NSSC不仅计划继续检查韩国领海，也将持续监测日本开展的相关活动。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea has tested a dispersal warhead for a strategic cruise missile, state media reported Tuesday. Full Gen. Kim Jong-sik, a member of the Workers' Party of Korea's Central Military Commission and first vice department director of the Central Committee, oversaw Monday's tests, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). "The Warhead Institute of the Missile Administration said it confirmed that the mid-sized dispersal warhead tipped on the cruise missile is capable of turning into ashes a target area of 5 to 6 hectares with its highest-density power," it said. The Cruise Missile System Institute said it perfected the missile's vertical strike capability by improving its terminal maneuverability, adjusted for the targeted area's natural and geographical characteristics. "The necessity of developing a variety of weapon systems is urgent than ever before. It is because our armed forces should defend the security of the country and deter all sorts of threats," the administration's director was quoted as saying. The tests, the director said, demonstrated "practical combat power." North Korea on Saturday tested a cluster bomb that can be mounted on tactical ballistic missiles and vowed to field various types of cluster warheads by the end of the year

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: North Korea on Tuesday flatly dismissed the outcome of a U.S. investigation that blamed Pyongyang for a massive cryptocurrency theft from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, calling it a "grave political provocation" against the North.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 朝鲜周二断然否定美国一项调查的结论。该调查将全球最大加密货币交易所币安遭遇的大规模加密货币盗窃案归咎于平壤，称这是针对朝鲜的“严重政治挑衅”。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: North Korea on Tuesday flatly dismissed the outcome of a U.S. investigation that blamed Pyongyang for a massive cryptocurrency theft from Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, calling it a "grave political provocation" against the North. Kim Yo-jong, the powerful sister of North Korean leader Kim Jong-un, made the remarks, referring to the U.S. Federal Bureau of Investigation's (FBI) announcement Saturday that the regime is responsible for the theft of more than US$6 billion in cryptocurrency from Binance. The FBI linked the theft to a North Korean hacking group it calls TraderTraitor, a name previously tied to other cryptocurrency heists. "The FBI is trying to brand the DPRK as a 'cyber criminal state', claiming that it obtained information that a hacking organization 'supported' by the DPRK was involved in the incident," Kim said in a statement carried by the North's official Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). DPRK is short for the North's official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK). "It is a grave political provocation against the DPRK that the U.S. misleads the international public opinion as if all the cyber crimes in different parts of the world are our deeds." North Korea has been blamed for cyber thefts before and has denied any involvement. It is rare for Kim to issue a statement on a hacking incident. Kim called Washington's accusation a "sinister" attempt to damage the international image of North Korea and undermine its dignity and national prestige, as well as another grave violation of the sovereignty of the North in cyberspace. Turning the blame back on Washington, she said, "As soon as the present U.S. administration took office last year, it announced that it would confiscate illegally stolen cryptocurrency assets and use them as a state's strategic reserve." She said North Korea is "closely monitoring a variety of what she called Washington's persistent provocations against it. "We have issues to reconsider in diverse aspects as regards the very unpleasant U.S. hostile attitude," Kim warned

Hosting the summit in Seoul will also put the spotlight on Korea's innovation ecosystem and efforts to strengthen university-industry collaboration, particularly in advanced technology sectors.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 《泰晤士高等教育》2026年创新与影响力峰会将于11月17日至19日在首尔的高丽大学举行，汇聚全球大学领导者和行业专家，探索将学术研究转化为具有商业可行性的技术和企业的途径。峰会在首尔举办还将 spotlight 韩国创新生态系统以及加强大学与产业合作的努力，特别是在先进技术领域。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The Times Higher Education (THE) Innovation & Impact Summit 2026 will take place at Korea University in Seoul from Nov. 17 to 19, bringing together global university leaders and industry experts to explore ways to turn academic research into commercially viable technologies and businesses. Under the theme "Universities, industry and investors: Connecting research with commercialisation," the three-day summit will examine strategies for strengthening cooperation between academia and industry, attracting investment and fostering innovation. The event comes as universities worldwide face growing pressure to demonstrate the economic and social impact of their research amid rapid advances in artificial intelligence (AI) and intensifying global competition for technological leadership. The event is expected to draw more than 300 participants from over 150 institutions and organizations worldwide, including university leaders, researchers, investors and industry experts. More than 80 speakers will take part in keynote speeches, panel discussions and workshops focused on translating academic breakthroughs into practical applications, attracting investment and building sustainable businesses. Discussions will focus on three key areas: turning academic research into commercial ventures, identifying investment opportunities in emerging technologies and strengthening collaboration between universities, industry and investors. Sessions will explore how universities can bring research breakthroughs to market through technology transfer, startups and industry partnerships, as well as ways to attract investment and scale promising innovations. The summit will also examine funding opportunities and gaps in strategic sectors, including AI, semiconductors, biotechnology, climate technology and advanced manufacturing. Another focus will be building competitive innovation ecosystems through new funding models, strategic partnerships and efforts to attract global talent and investment. Discussions will also address growing global competition for research talent, investment and technological expertise. The summit will feature Darren Cooke, chief innovation and entrepreneurship officer at the University of California, Berkeley, alongside other leaders from academia, industry and investment organizations. Other notable speakers include Korea Institute for Advancement of Technology President Jeon Yun-jong, Finda CEO and co-founder Lee Hye-min, QUBIS CEO Marina Donohoe and Uniseed CEO Alastair Hick. Hosting the summit in Seoul will also put the spotlight on Korea's innovation ecosystem and efforts to strengthen university-industry collaboration, particularly in advanced technology sectors. Korea University, which is hosting the event, highlighted the importance of international cooperation in advancing innovation and addressing challenges facing higher education. The university said it aims to harness AI, sustainability and human-centered innovation to shape the future of higher education, while encouraging participants to exchange ideas, forge partnerships and translate research into tangible outcomes. Furthermore, the summit will provide opportunities for university leaders, researchers, entrepreneurs and investors to build partnerships and explore potential funding opportunities. Registration is open through the event's official website , with discounted rates available for startups and groups of three or more
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 首尔将举行峰会，探索如何将大学研究成果转化为商业项目
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 《泰晤士高等教育》（THE）2026创新与影响力峰会将于11月17日至19日在首尔高丽大学举行，汇聚全球大学领导者和行业专家，探索将学术研究转化为具有商业可行性的技术和企业的方法。此次为期三天的峰会以“大学、产业与投资者：连接研究与商业化”为主题，将研究加强学术界与产业界合作、吸引投资和推动创新的战略。随着人工智能（AI）迅速发展以及全球争夺技术领导权的竞争日益加剧，世界各地的大学正面临越来越大压力，需要证明其研究产生的经济和社会影响。预计将有来自全球150多家机构和组织的300多名参与者，包括大学领导者、研究人员、投资者和行业专家。80多名发言人将围绕将学术突破转化为实际应用、吸引投资和打造可持续企业等主题发表主旨演讲、参加专题讨论并举行工作坊。讨论将聚焦三个关键领域：将学术研究转化为商业项目，发掘新兴技术领域的投资机会，以及加强大学、产业与投资者之间的合作。各场会议将探讨大学如何通过技术转让、初创企业和产业合作将研究突破推向市场，以及如何吸引投资并扩大有前景的创新成果。峰会还将研究包括AI、半导体、生物技术、气候技术和先进制造在内的战略领域的融资机会和资金缺口。另一项重点是通过新的融资模式、战略合作伙伴关系以及吸引全球人才和投资的努力，建设具有竞争力的创新生态系统。讨论还将涉及全球对研究人才、投资和技术专长日益加剧的竞争。加利福尼亚大学伯克利分校首席创新与创业官Darren Cooke将出席峰会，其他来自学术界、产业界和投资组织的领导者也将参会。其他值得关注的发言人包括韩国国家技术 advancement院院长Jeon Yun-jong、Finda首席执行官兼联合创始人Lee Hye-min、QUBIS首席执行官Marina Donohoe以及Uniseed首席执行官Alastair Hick。在首尔举办峰会还将使韩国的创新生态系统以及加强大学与产业界合作的努力成为焦点，尤其是先进技术领域的合作。承办此次活动的高丽大学强调，国际合作对于推动创新和应对高等教育面临的挑战至关重要。该大学表示，旨在利用AI、可持续性和以人为本的创新塑造高等教育的未来，同时鼓励参与者交流想法、建立合作关系并将研究成果转化为实际成果。此外，峰会将为大学领导者、研究人员、创业者和投资者搭建合作平台并探索潜在融资机会。报名可通过活动官方网站进行，初创企业和三人及以上团体可享受优惠价格

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110308.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 권희원 기자 = 국민의힘은 3일 정부의 내년도 예산안에 대한 국회 심사와 관련, "반도체 호황으로 늘어난 일시적 세수에 기대 빚으로 현금을 푸는 예산안은 민생을 향한 선전포고"라면서 공세를 이어갔다. 박충권 수석대변인도 이날 논평에서 "이번 대통령의 예산 시정연설은 '모두의 성장'이라는 탈을 쓴 미래 약탈에 불과하다"며 "미래대응기금 내년 지출 45조 4천억 원 가운데 34%, 15조 5천억 원이 현금성 복지"라고 비판했다. 이어 "생색내기 현금 대신 골목경제를 지키는 예산부터 챙기고, '모두의 성장'이 구호가 아닌 숫자로 증명되는지 끝까지 따져 물을 것"이라고 강조했다. 김태규 원내수석대변인도 논평에서 이재명 대통령의 전날 정부 예산안 시정연설과 관련, "대통령의 말과 달리 내년 국가채무는 106조원 넘게 늘어난다. 정부가 내년에 찍어내는 국고채 222조8천억원 가운데 절반이 고스란히 새 빚인데도 이 대통령은 빚이 거의 늘지 않는다며 국민을 속였다"고 말했다. 이어 "이 대통령은 12월 2일까지 예산안을 처리해 달라고 했지만, 국민을 속이며 내민 예산안에 결코 도장을 찍을 수 없다"며 "106조원 빚을 '거의 없다'고 한 거짓 설명부터 국민 앞에 사과하라"고 촉구했다. 3선 성일종 의원도 이날 MBC 라디오 '김종배의 시선집중'에 출연해 "국채는 더 늘리면서 더 들어온 163조원을 국회의 통제를 안 받고 쓸 수 있는 미래대응기금으로 만들었다"며 "비 올 때 우산을 준비할 수 없는 것"이라고 지적했다. 국민의힘 유승민 전 의원도 이날 KBS 라디오 '전격 인터뷰'에 출연해 미래대응기금과 관련, "'일반 회계'가 아닌 '기금'으로 해 쌈짓돈을 만들어놓으면 국회의 통제·감시·견제'가 약해진다"며 "세금이 갑자기 느는 것은 일종의 '로또'라고 봐야 하는데 이걸 가지고 이 대통령이 돈을 그냥 막 쓰는 것"이라고 비판했다. 그는 "'재주는 곰이 부리고 돈은 왕서방이 챙긴다'는 말처럼 재주는 반도체가 부리고 돈은 완전히 '이 서방'이 챙기는 꼴"이라며 "대통령이 국가 채무 비율을 말씀하신 부분은 굉장히 정직하지 못했다"고 지적했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/03 11:39 송고 2026년11월03일 11시39분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 한상균 기자 = 국민의힘 정점식 원내대표가 2일 국회에서 이재명 대통령 2027년도 예산안 시정연설 관련 기자간담회를 하고 있다. 2026.11.2 xyz@yna.co.kr
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110308.title_zh: 国 힘称“掠夺未来、靠负债敛财”……明年预算案将成众矢之的
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110308.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）权熙元记者＝国民力量党3日就国会审议政府下一年度预算案一事继续主张加税，并称：“这是一份仰赖半导体繁荣带来的临时性税收增长、以举债方式发放现金的预算案，无异于对民生发出的虚假宣言。”朴忠权首席议员当天也在评论文章中表示：“总统此次预算施政演说不过是披着‘共同增长’外衣的未来掠夺。”他批评称：“未来应对基金明年45万亿4千亿韩元的支出中，34%、即15万亿5千亿韩元属于现金福利。”他强调：“与其粉饰以现金发放福利，不如先准备一份守护街坊经济的预算；我也会彻底追问‘共同增长’能否不只是一句口号，而是用数字得到证明。”国民力量党院内首席议员金太圭当天也在评论文章中就李在明总统前一天发表的政府预算案施政演说表示：“与总统的说法相反，明年国家债务将增加超过106万亿韩元。政府明年发行的222万亿8千亿韩元国债中，一半原封不动地成为新增债务，但总统却欺骗国民说债务几乎没有增加。”他进一步表示：“总统要求在12月2日前处理完预算案，但他欺骗国民提交的预算案绝不可能盖章批准。应先就‘几乎没有106万亿韩元债务’这一虚假说法向国民道歉。”三议员成日钟当天出演MBC电台《金钟培的视线集中》节目并指出：“国债继续增加，却把增加后的163万亿韩元装进不受国会控制的未来应对基金里。”他批评称：“这就像下雨时连伞都没准备。”国民力量党前议员刘承民当天也出演KBS电台《全力访谈》节目，就未来应对基金表示：“如果把‘一般会计’改成‘基金’，编造所谓的交换资金，国会的控制、监督和制约就会减弱。”他批评称：“税收突然增长堪比一种‘彩票’，而拿着这种钱，总统就可以肆意花钱。”他说：“就像‘本事是狗熊挣的，钱都让财迷老爷拿走了’这句话一样，半导体在挣钱，而钱全被‘这位财迷老爷’拿走。”他还指出：“总统在谈到国家债务比率时，表现得极不诚实。”对此可利用KakaoTalk okjebo咨询。版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载和再发布，禁止用于AI学习及使用。2026/11/03 11:39发布，2026年11月3日11时39分发布（首尔=韩联社）韩相均记者＝国民力量党最高院内代表2日在国会就李在明总统2027年度预算案施政演说举行记者恳谈会。2026.11.2 xyz@yna.co.kr

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110301.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）尹宝蓝记者、Jeon Myung-hoon记者=朝鲜连续进行动用弹道导弹和巡航导弹的集束弹头试验，再次展示其大范围杀伤力和精确打击能力。朝鲜中央通讯社3日报道称，导弹总局前一天进行了战略巡航导弹“散射战斗部”威力评估试验和垂直打击飞行特性试验。上月31日，朝鲜刚进行战术弹道导弹所搭载的散射战斗部（集束弹头）威力评估试验，时隔两天又将适用对象扩大至巡航导弹，展开了追加试验。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110301.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 윤보람 전명훈 기자 = 북한이 탄도미사일과 순항미사일을 동원한 집속탄두 시험을 연이어 감행하면서 광역 살상력과 함께 정밀 타격 능력을 거듭 과시했다. 조선중앙통신은 3일 미사일총국이 전날 전략순항미사일 '산포전투부' 위력평가시험과 수직타격비행특성시험을 진행했다고 보도했다. 지난달 31일 전술탄도미사일에 탑재하는 산포전투부(집속탄 탄두) 위력평가시험을 진행한 지 이틀 만에 적용 대상을 순항미사일로 넓혀 추가 시험에 나선 것이다. 미사일총국 산하 전투부연구소는 시험 결과를 발표하면서 "순항미싸일에 장착된 중형산포전투부로 5∼6정보(1정보는 약 9천917㎡로 대략 1㏊)의 표적 구역을 초강력 밀도로 초토화할 수 있다는 것을 확증하였다"고 주장했다. 5∼6정보는 축구장 7∼8개에 해당하는 면적이다. 산포전투부는 하나의 탄두 안에 여러 개의 자탄(새끼탄)을 넣은 집속탄두(확산탄·cluster bomb)를 일컫는다. 공중에서 폭발하면서 자탄이 사방으로 확산해 살상력을 극대화한 무기다. 북한 미사일총국 순항미사일체계연구소는 또 "무기체계 적용 지대의 자연지리적 특성을 고려하여 순항미싸일의 말기기동 특성을 향상시킴으로써 대상물에 대한 수직타격 능력을 완성하였다"고도 주장했다. 이날 조선중앙통신을 통해 공개된 사진에는 미사일이 바다 위에서 자탄을 수면으로 퍼뜨리는 장면, 포병진지·탄약고 등 한국군 시설을 모사한 것으로 추정되는 시설을 미사일이 거의 수직 방향으로 타격하는 장면 등이 담겼다. 신종우 한국국방안보포럼(KODEF) 사무총장은 북한이 '수직 타격 능력'을 완성했다고 밝힌 데 대해 "수평·사선 방향으로는 공격하기 어려운 한국군의 지하 시설, 터널 입구 등의 표적을 정밀 타격하려는 의도"라며 "중력 가속도를 이용해 표적에 탄착하기 전 속도를 최대한 높여 파괴력을 극대화하는 방식"이라고 분석했다. 이날 북한이 시험한 순항미사일은 고위력 탄두, 집속탄 탄두를 각각 탑재한 '화살' 계열 순항미사일인 것으로 신 사무총장은 추정했다. 군은 이날 북한이 밝힌 시험 결과에 대해 "북한의 어떠한 도발에도 압도적으로 대응할 수 있는 능력과 태세를 유지하고 있다"고 밝혔다. 장도영 합동참모본부 공보실장은 이날 정례브리핑에서 관련 질문을 받고 "우리 군은 북한의 관련 동향을 예의주시하고 있으며 한미 간 현재 정밀 분석 중"이라고 강조했다. 북한이 연쇄적으로 집속탄을 시험한 데 대해서는 "우리 군은 기술적인 측면에서 북한이 주장하는 기술을 압도하는 정밀타격 능력과 관련 무기체계를 이미 20년 전에 개발해 구비하고 있으며, 상시 운용태세를 유지하고 있다"고 강조했다. 군이 전날 북한의 미사일 발사시험을 언론에 실시간 공지하지 않은 것과 관련해서는 "특정 발사체의 포착 여부를 일일이 확인하는 것은 우리 군의 감시능력을 북한에 노출하는 결과를 초래해 적절하지 않다"며 "군이 보유한 대응 능력과 자산의 세부 제원을 대외적으로 공개하지 않는 것은 북한에 패를 보여주지 않기 위한 전략적·군사적 판단"이라고 강조했다. 합참은 유엔 안보리 제재 위반인 북한의 탄도미사일 발사에 대해서는 포착 즉시 언론에 실시간 공지하지만, 탄도미사일이 아닌 순항미사일 등 다른 발사체에 대해서는 실시간으로 발표하지 않는 경우가 많다. 장 실장은 이어 "순항미사일은 속도가 느리고 저고도로 지형을 우회하는 특성이 있다"며 "북한이 북쪽 먼 지역에서 발사할 경우에 지구 곡률 등의 이유로 탐지가 제한되는 경우가 있을 수 있다"고 부연했다. 그러면서 "북한이 우리 쪽으로 순항미사일을 발사한다면 충분히 탐지 및 대응이 가능하고, 현재 우리 군은 이에 대한 확고한 군사대비태세를 갖추고 있다"고 덧붙였다. 한편 이날 북한은 이틀 전 탄도미사일용 집속탄두 시험 때와 마찬가지로 이번 미사일 시험 사실을 주민이 보는 노동당 기관지 노동신문 등 대내용 매체에는 공개하지 않았다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110301.title_zh: 朝鲜再次试射弹道导弹……此次还展示巡航导弹“垂直打击”能力（综合报道）
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026110301.body_zh: （首尔＝韩联社）尹宝蓝 全明勋记者＝朝鲜接连进行动用弹道导弹和巡航导弹的集束弹头试验，再次展示了其大范围杀伤力和精确打击能力。朝鲜中央通讯社3日报道称，朝鲜导弹总局前一天进行了战略巡航导弹“산포전투부”威力评估试验和垂直打击飞行特性试验。继上月31日进行战术弹道导弹所搭载的산포전투부（集束弹头）威力评估试验后，时隔两天又扩大适用对象至巡航导弹，展开了追加试验。导弹总局下属战斗部研究所在公布试验结果时声称：“已证实，装载于巡航导弹上的中型산포전투부能够以超强密度将相当于5至6町步（1町步约为9917平方米，约合1公顷）的目标区域夷为平地。”5至6町步的面积相当于7至8个足球场。산포전투부是将在一个弹头内装入多个子弹药（小型炸弹）的集束弹头（扩散弹、cluster bomb）的统称。这是一种在空中爆炸时使子弹药向四周扩散，从而将杀伤力最大化的武器。朝鲜导弹总局巡航导弹体系研究所还声称：“考虑了武器体系适用地区的自然地理特征，通过提升巡航导弹的末端机动性能，完善了对目标实施垂直打击的能力。”当天通过朝鲜中央通讯社公开的图片显示，导弹在海面上将子弹药扩散至水面，以及导弹几乎沿垂直方向打击疑似模拟韩军炮兵阵地、弹药库等设施的场景。韩国国防安保论坛（KODEF）事务总长申钟宇就朝鲜宣称已完善“垂直打击能力”表示：“这表明其意图是精确打击难以从水平或斜向实施攻击的韩军地下设施、隧道入口等目标”，并分析称，“这种方式利用重力加速度，在命中目标前尽可能提高速度，以最大化破坏力”。他推测，当天朝鲜试验的巡航导弹是分别搭载高威力弹头和集束弹头的“箭”系列巡航导弹。韩军当天就朝鲜公布的试验结果表示：“军队仍保持能够以压倒性优势应对朝鲜任何挑衅的能力和战备态势。”联参本部公宣传室长张度永当天在例行记者会上回答相关问题时强调：“我军正密切注意朝鲜的相关动向，目前正对美韩两军情况进行分析。”就朝鲜接连试验集束弹一事，他强调：“从技术层面看，我军早在20年前就已开发并装备了能够压倒朝鲜所宣称技术的精确打击能力及相关武器体系，目前保持着常态化运用战备状态。”就军方前一天未向媒体实时通报朝鲜导弹试射试验一事，他强调称：“逐一确认特定发射体是否被截获，可能暴露我军监视能力，并不适宜；不对外公开军队所具备的应对能力和装备的具体性能参数，是为避免向朝鲜示弱而作出的战略和军事判断。”联参方面表示，对于违反联合国安理会制裁的朝鲜弹道导弹发射，截获后会立即向媒体实时通报；但对于巡航导弹等非弹道导弹等发射体，通常不会实时发布消息。张室长随后补充说：“巡航导弹具有速度较慢、以低高度绕开地形的特点”，“如果朝鲜从北方偏远地区发射，受地球曲率等因素影响，有时会限制探测能力”。他并强调：“即使朝鲜向我们发射巡航导弹，也完全能够探测并加以应对，目前我军已为此做好充分军事准备。”另据当天报道，朝鲜此次并未向居民看到的劳动党机关报《劳动新闻》等对内宣传媒体公开导弹试验情况，与两天前进行弹道导弹用集束弹头试验时相同。举报请通过KakaoTalk联系okjebo＜版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载、复制及用于人工智能学习和利用＞2026/11/03 11:37发稿 2026年11月3日11时37分发稿（平壤，朝鲜中央通讯社＝韩联社）朝鲜中央通讯社3日报道称，朝鲜导弹总局于2日在金正日朝鲜劳动党中央军事委员兼党中央委员会第一副部长指导下，进行了战略巡航导弹산포전투부（集束弹头）威力评估试验和垂直打击飞行特性试验。2026.11.3 [仅限韩国境内使用，禁止转载。For Use Only in the Republic of Korea.
